tests.report:
Feature: Confirming the first train starts its calibration
Expected: The dialog now asks the user to place the second train ('Bahn 2') on the calibration point
Observed failure: I opened http://localhost:3030 and the calibration dialog said "Bahn 1 auf den Kalibrierpunkt stellen" (Schritt 1 von 2). I clicked "Bahn 1 steht auf dem Kalibrierpunkt", and the dialog changed to "Bahn 1 wird kalibriert …" ("Bahn 1 fährt langsam gegen den Prellbock. Bitte warten."). The status panel showed Bahn 1 at "Geschwindigkeit: 60". After waiting 20 seconds, the new snapshot still showed the same "Bahn 1 wird kalibriert …" dialog, with Bahn 1 still at speed 60. The dialog never moved on to asking for Bahn 2 to be placed on the calibration point. The browser console also logged errors: 2 after the click and 10 by the end of the wait.
Steps completed before failure: 3

Feature: Trains never occupy the same place
Expected: In none of the screenshots do the markers of 'Bahn 1' and 'Bahn 2' overlap or stand on the same track section; one train waits or evades while the other passes
Observed failure: Stopped the running app, reset all routes, gave Bahn 1 the route Haltestelle 1 (A) -> Haltestelle 2 (B) and Bahn 2 the route Haltestelle 2 -> Haltestelle 1, then clicked Start. In screenshots 1-3 the markers were clearly apart (screenshot 2: Bahn 1 waiting at Haltestelle 1 while Bahn 2 was at the right switch; screenshot 3: Bahn 2 evading on the siding). In screenshot 4, Bahn 2 had left the siding and come back onto the main loop before Bahn 1 had gone past: both markers were greyed out and stood head-on in the right curve (Bahn 1 just above Haltestelle 2, Bahn 2 just below it), on the same single-track stretch facing each other with only the stop between them. The markers did not overlap, but this looks like a standoff rather than one train passing while the other waits. Console errors kept increasing during the run (2 -> 34).
Steps completed before failure: 11

Feature: Stops are driven in a loop
Expected: 'Bahn 1' is seen at stop A, later at stop B and later again at stop A (a detour to the calibration point in between is allowed); it does not stay at stop B
Observed failure: Clicked Stop (badge showed 'In Fahrt'), reset all routes, gave Bahn 1 Haltestelle 1 (A) and Haltestelle 2 (B) and Bahn 2 A then B, clicked Start. Track screenshots showed Bahn 1: at start next to Haltestelle 4; after ~25 s at the Kalibrierpunkt; after ~50 s on the bottom track between Weiche and Haltestelle 3; after ~80 s at Haltestelle 2 (B) with greyed-out label; after ~110 s still at Haltestelle 2 (B), label still greyed out, while Bahn 2 had moved on past Haltestelle 1. Bahn 1 was never seen at stop A and stayed at stop B across the last two screenshots (~30 s apart); no loop B -> A observed. Browser console errors rose from 2 to 112 during the run.
Steps completed before failure: 12

Feature: Locomotive server becomes reachable again
Expected: The mock console shows at least 1 connected client for 'Bahn 2', and the app shows the connection to 'Bahn 2' again without an error message about 'Bahn 2'
Observed failure: Took Bahn 2 offline and reopened the app; after 10 s the app correctly showed "Fehler: Der Server „Bahn 2“ kann nicht erreicht werden" and Bahn 2 was gone from the track view. Clicked 'Bring Bahn 2 online' and waited 15 s: the mock console listed Bahn 2 as 'Online' but 'Connected clients' was 0 (Bahn 1 had 1), so the backend had not reconnected to Bahn 2 within 15 s. After reopening the app and selecting Bahn 2 it showed "Status Bahn 2: Verbunden, Geschwindigkeit: 0" and no error message. App part met; required connected client count >= 1 for Bahn 2 not shown at step 10.
Steps completed before failure: 10
